root_cause_label: Agent gave up after visual inspection failed, ignoring programmatic image analysis alternatives
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent abandoned the task after being unable to visually view the chess board image in the interface, calling finish() without attempting programmatic board extraction via computer vision or chess libraries.
t_err_evidence: Step 2: The agent chose to visualize the image via matplotlib (plt.imshow) under the false premise that it could visually read the board from the rendered plot, instead of pursuing programmatic piece detection or image-parsing approaches.
t_commit_evidence: Step 3: The agent calls finish() requesting external input (FEN or image in chat), locking in task failure without producing /app/move.txt.
t_surface_evidence: Step 3: The finish() call explicitly states inability to proceed and requests human intervention, surfacing the failure with no required output file written.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that reading the chess board position requires visual inspection of the rendered image (which is not viewable in the terminal interface), ignoring feasible programmatic alternatives such as computer vision-based piece detection, chess board parsing libraries, or using a chess engine with the image as input.
